title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends his best wishes to all the pilgrims setting out to offer prayers at the Amarnath Yatra, which commenced today
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends his best wishes to all the pilgrims setting out to offer prayers at the Amarnath Yatra, which commenced today

Shri Amarnath Ji Yatra is a sacred symbol of unwavering faith in Sanatan culture, steadfast patience, self-restraint, and an indomitable spirit that never gives up
The Modi govt. put in place a multi-layer security grid along the pilgrimage route, QR code-based registration, and robust arrangements for pilgrim accommodation, healthcare services, and disaster management

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
03 JUL 2026 7:58PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah has extended his best wishes to all the pilgrims embarking on the Amarnath Yatra, which commenced today, for their pilgrimage and prayers.

In a post on X, Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah said, “The Amarnath Ji Yatra is a sacred symbol of unwavering devotion to Sanatan culture, steadfast patience, restraint, and an indomitable spirit that never accepts defeat. Today marks the auspicious commencement of this holy journey. My best wishes to all devotees heading for the darshan and worship of Baba Barfani. The Modi government has made robust arrangements along the entire route, including a multi-layer security grid, QR code-based registration, and strengthened facilities for devotees' accommodation, healthcare services, and disaster management, ensuring that every pilgrim's journey remains safe, smooth, and joyful. Har-Har Mahadev!

श्री अमरनाथ जी की यात्रा सनातन संस्कृति के प्रति अटूट श्रद्धा, अडिग धैर्य, संयम और कभी हार न मानने वाली जीवटता का पावन प्रतीक है। आज से इस पवित्र यात्रा का शुभारंभ हो रहा है। बाबा बर्फानी के दर्शन-पूजन हेतु जाने वाले सभी श्रद्धालुओं को शुभकामनाएँ।
मोदी सरकार द्वारा संपूर्ण यात्रा…
— Amit Shah (@AmitShah)
July 3, 2026

***
